import glob,re,json,collections
LABELS=re.compile(r'^(Respondent|Other Party|Case Number|Date of Advisory Meeting|Date of Damage|Damage Location|Abstentions|Additional Information)\s*:')
out=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/r2run-cu48jc73/data/text/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    parts=re.split(r'^=== page (\d+)\s*$',t,flags=re.M)
    for pg,body in zip(parts[1::2],parts[2::2]):
        lines=[l.strip() for l in body.split('\n')]
        lines=[l for l in lines if l]
        idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('Respondent:')]
        if not idx: continue
        r=idx[0]
        # block: from Respondent line to 'Date of Advisory' or 'The IURC' line
        end=None
        for j in range(r,len(lines)):
            if lines[j].startswith('The IURC Pipeline') or lines[j].startswith('Date of Advisory'):
                end=j;break
        if end is None: end=min(len(lines),r+8)
        blk=lines[r:end]
        inline=re.match(r'^Respondent:\s*(.*)$',lines[r]).group(1).strip()
        # values in block not labels
        vals=[l for l in blk if not LABELS.match(l)]
        # also inline other party / case number
        other=None; case=None
        for l in blk:
            m=re.match(r'^Other Party:\s*(.*)$',l)
            if m and m.group(1).strip(): other=m.group(1).strip()
            m=re.match(r'^Case Number:\s*(.*)$',l)
            if m and m.group(1).strip(): case=m.group(1).strip()
        out.append(dict(file=f.split('/')[-1],page=int(pg),inline=inline,other=other,case=case,vals=vals,blk=blk))
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/r2run-cu48jc73/../'+'x','w')) if False else None
import pickle,os
pickle.dump(out,open(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/tmp')+'/cases.pkl','wb'))
print(len(out))
c=collections.Counter()
for o in out:
    c[(bool(o['inline']), len(o['vals'])>0, bool(o['case']))]+=1
print(c)
EOF

import glob,re,pickle,collections
LAB=re.compile(r'^(Respondent|Other Party|Case Number|Date of Advisory Meeting|Date of Damage|Damage Location|Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED)\s*:?')
res=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/r2run-cu48jc73/data/text/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    parts=re.split(r'^=== page (\d+)\s*$',t,flags=re.M)
    for pg,body in zip(parts[1::2],parts[2::2]):
        L=[l.strip() for l in body.split('\n') if l.strip()]
        ri=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if l.startswith('Respondent:')]
        if not ri: continue
        ri=ri[0]
        ti=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if l.startswith('The IURC Pipeline')]
        ti=ti[0] if ti else len(L)
        # standard inline?
        inline=re.match(r'^Respondent:\s*(.*)$',L[ri]).group(1).strip()
        oi=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if i>ri and l.startswith('Other Party:')]
        oi=oi[0] if oi else None
        # alt-format values: lines after last label line before ti
        lab_idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(L[:ti]) if LAB.match(l) and not l.startswith('APPROVED')]
        last=max(lab_idx) if lab_idx else ri
        vals=L[last+1:ti]
        # drop vals that are labels-with-text (should be none)
        rec=dict(file=f.split('/')[-1],page=int(pg),inline=inline,vals=vals,mode=None,resp=None,other=None,case=None)
        if inline:
            rec['mode']='std'
            cont=[]
            if oi is not None:
                cont=[l for l in L[ri+1:oi] if not LAB.match(l)]
            rec['resp']=' '.join([inline]+cont)
            m=re.match(r'^Other Party:\s*(.*)$',L[oi]) if oi is not None else None
            rec['other']=m.group(1) if m else None
        elif vals:
            rec['mode']='alt'
            k=None
            for j,v in enumerate(vals[:4]):
                if re.fullmatch(r'\d{3,6}',v): k=j;break
            if k is None: rec['mode']='alt?'
            elif k==2: rec['resp'],rec['other']=vals[0],vals[1]
            elif k==3: rec['resp'],rec['other']=vals[0]+' '+vals[1],vals[2]
            else: rec['resp']=None
            rec['case']=vals[k] if k is not None else None
        else:
            rec['mode']='blank'
        res.append(rec)
pickle.dump(res,open('/tmp/r2tmp-701bbamz/claude-1000/cases2.pkl','wb'))
print(collections.Counter(r['mode'] for r in res))
EOF
